vocabulary_trigger_manual_description: Someone who can manage workflow triggers starts a run.
vocabulary_trigger_schedule_description: The run starts once at a fixed time.
vocabulary_trigger_condition_description: A monitored fact matches a value, such as stock below its minimum.
vocabulary_step_read_description: Get fresh data from a connected system.
vocabulary_step_condition_description: Continue only when a field has a specific value.
vocabulary_step_capability_description: Ask a connected system to make a change. Luma checks your approval rules first.
vocabulary_step_approval_description: Wait for someone who can approve changes to decide on the next action.
vocabulary_step_wait_description: Pause for a fixed time before continuing.
vocabulary_step_verification_description: Read the data again, independently, to confirm the change worked.
vocabulary_step_escalation_description: Stop and hand the run to a person.
vocabulary_step_end_description: Finish the run with a named outcome.
vocabulary_step_code_description: Compute values with TypeScript, run in isolation, when the builder isn’t enough.
vocabulary_subject_order_description: A sales order in a connected shop or ERP.
vocabulary_subject_inventory_position_de: A linked SKU at one inventory location.
vocabulary_subject_purchase_order_descri: A purchase order recorded in Procurement.
vocabulary_step_human_task_description: Assign work, collect evidence and continue when answered.
vocabulary_step_event_wait_description: Wait for a correlated business event within a deadline.
